model.name: Deep-link ?repo seeds BOTH left and right repo selectors on load
model.description: When the 3-way diff/merge editor opens from a deep-link with ?repo=<key>, BOTH the left AND the right repo selectors MUST be seeded to that repo on load. BUG (v0.7.61, Tron screenshot): neither selector is seeded from ?repo - both stay at the default (RawBin), so Tron had to set BOTH manually. openFromParams (rb-diff-editor.ts:771) sets this.left.repo + this.right.repo from the key and runs a .de-repo forEach, yet the selectors still show the default on load - so the fix-site is NOT the naive data-set (a later populateRepos, or a distinct right selector, re-defaults them). Impl-site pending expert+architect derive-confirm. crossRef R30.24 (openFromParams deep-link seeding) + R30.6.7 (RepoRegistry key resolution).
model.tronQuote: > TRON (v0.7.61, screenshot): the ?repo query param must seed BOTH left AND right repo selectors on load - i had to set BOTH manually, neither was seeded (only default RawBin).
model.crossRefNote: Refines the R30.24 deep-link seeding (openFromParams f52b6941, marker dc236c19): the URL restore seeds left but the RIGHT selector still shows default RawBin (Tron: neither seeded). R30.6.7 RepoRegistry resolves the ?repo KEY. Distinct new bug -> next-free R30.39, not a silent edit to R30.24.

discoverySource.note: 3-way editor bug A: ?repo seeds neither left nor right selector; both default RawBin; user forced to set both by hand. Expert to root-cause the actual seed/reset site (openFromParams .de-repo forEach vs populateRepos).

model.implSitePending: openFromParams f52b6941 sets left/right st.repo + a .de-repo forEach but selectors still default -> real fix may be in populateRepos / per-side selector init. Expert+architect derive-confirm; I mint/re-point the Impl to the built decl.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Opening the editor from a deep-link with ?repo=<key> seeds BOTH the left AND the right repo selectors to that repo on load - neither is left at the default (RawBin).
The user does NOT have to set either selector manually after a ?repo deep-link; both reflect the URL's repo immediately.
The ?repo value is a KEY resolved via R30.6.7 RepoRegistry (no client absolute-path abuse); an unknown/absent key falls back to the default (rawbin) for BOTH selectors.

GATE (DET-3x + Tron visual): open /edit/otmux?repo=oosh&left=..&right=..&3way=1 -> both left and right selectors read 'oosh' on load, no manual setting; client-facing -> version-bump + atomic deploy (R30.28).
